## What this changes

Briefly describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type

- [ ] `feat` new capability
- [ ] `fix` bug fix
- [ ] `docs` documentation only
- [ ] `test` tests or evals
- [ ] `refactor` no behaviour change
- [ ] `chore` tooling or maintenance
- [ ] `ci` pipeline

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] `python tools/validate_skill.py skills/` passes (`python3` on macOS and Linux).
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests` passes.
- [ ] `SKILL.md` is still under 500 lines.
- [ ] No content copied from third-party sites, design systems, or other skills.
- [ ] Any new source is credited in `CREDITS.md`.
- [ ] Any new rule is checkable, not vague.
- [ ] Any new font is SIL Open Font License and available on Google Fonts.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]`.

## Notes for the reviewer

Decisions made, assumptions taken, and anything left open.
